title: Influence bound from noise sensitivity
statement: Let $n,m,k$ be natural numbers with $2\le n$. Suppose that for every natural number $r$, every Boolean function on the $r$-dimensional sign cube of polynomial threshold degree at most $k$, and every noise parameter $\delta\in[0,1/2]$, the noise sensitivity at $\delta$ is at most $\varepsilon(\delta)$, where $\varepsilon$ takes values in $[0,1]$. If $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube of polynomial threshold degree at most $k$, then its total influence is at most $\frac{2n}{1-e^{-2}}\,\varepsilon(1/n)$.
